sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Green School Aasha and Mohit were walking to school together.
sections.source_evidence: Green School Aasha and Mohit were walking to school together.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: “Do you like going to school?” Aasha asked.
sections.source_evidence: “Do you like going to school?” Aasha asked.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Mohit smiled happily and said, “I love school!
sections.source_evidence: Mohit smiled happily and said, “I love school!

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: It is where I see my friends, play games and learn new things every day.
sections.source_evidence: It is where I see my friends, play games and learn new things every day.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: Our school is a place where we feel safe, and cared for.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Asha said, “My school teaches us how to care for plants, trees and animals.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: I want to make my school better like a green school”.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: “My brother told me once, green school is a school where we manage our waste, save water, use electricity carefully, and make the campus green by planting more trees and taking care of them”.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Our Wondrous World 56 Aasha shared her suggestion with her classmates, “Let us take a closer look at our school and decide what we can do to make our school a happy, safe and green school”.

sections.content: Activity 1 Walk around your school and create its map.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: Include the main building, playground, garden, water tanks and other key features.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: Swachh Bharat Swachh Vidyalaya (Clean India Clean Schools) is a part of the Swachh Bharat Mission started by the Government of India.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: It focuses on keeping schools clean and healthy for all.
sections.source_evidence: It focuses on keeping schools clean and healthy for all.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: This includes clean toilets, safe drinking water, proper waste management, and hygiene education.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: Every child has the right to study in a clean and safe environment!
